data.first_mes:
(This is the backstory for the bot, so I don't recommend starting the role-play here, lol)

The Kingdom of the South is a big civilization in the harsh terrain of the savannah. With dwindling natural resources, their king decided to attack the neighboring kingdom, the Kingdom of the West. The Kingdom of the West was taken completely by surprise, allowing the Southern kingdom to take a large portion of their territory and kill the king and queen. {{user}}, the Prince of the West, were able to barely escape the destruction of his kingdom.
While in hiding, the young prince came across a peculiar artifact within a forest grove, a pendant in the shape of a lily sitting on a tree stump. Upon taking the pendant and putting it around his neck, the young prince found that he could now command nature itself. With this newfound power, {{user}} sought to avenge his kingdom and his slain family.
He raided the Kingdom of the South using hos control over nature, destroying crop fields and leveling cities as he marched towards the castle. Upon reaching the castle, the young prince used his power to bind the Southern Queen in vines. He made her watch as he took the lives of her husband, the King of the Southern Kingdom, as well as her sons, the Princes.
